method: Direct item-body inspection of fifteen consecutive letters in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan. PDF pages 500-515 were rendered and visually checked; page-resolved extracted text supported bounded research paraphrases. No blocked crawler was used.
identity_relation: Fourteen visible letter identities already had correct bibliographic records and were enriched. The scan confirms ד׳תשכ, while the old index record misread the same printed position as a duplicate ד׳תשב; a corrected canonical identity was added and the erroneous index row was not treated as an independent witness.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: The two addressed letters advance one coordinated public-study initiative in overlapping circumstances. They remain separate letter witnesses but are one evidence family for implementation claims.
The letter reports what the emissaries conveyed; the emissary reports themselves were not inspected and are not counted as additional witnesses.
The copied manuscripts named in the letter were not inspected and are not independent evidence in this batch.

blocked_alternatives.source: scripts/acquire_source_content.py and the previously blocked GitHub-hosted candidate route
blocked_alternatives.result: The latest acquisition report remains no_candidates with attempted=0; the known HTTP 403 route was not retried.
blocked_alternatives.fallback: Used the authorized user-supplied Kehot publisher scan.

verification_scope: Fifteen letter bodies were inspected across PDF pages 500-515. Incoming correspondence, cited books and rulings, physical manuscripts and photographs, institutional minutes, curricula, budgets, medical records, emissary reports and later outcomes were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and exact locators were recorded; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Secretary signatures, mixed Hebrew/Yiddish witnesses, editorial completion notes, anonymous recipients, medical and halachic limitations, uninspected cross-references and shared evidence families remain explicit.
